basis.heading: Assumptions
basis.body: 6-handed. Blinds 50/100 (BB is 100), everyone starts with 10,000 chips (100 big blinds), no rake. Only heads-up spots. Solver: postflop-solver (b-inary, free). Ranges are our own and are not a theoretical truth.
basis.grading: 🟩 EV loss ≤ {g}% of pot   🟨 ≤ {y}%, or GTO takes it ≥ {f}% of the time   🟥 otherwise

privacy.heading: Privacy
privacy.body:
Daily Poker uses Google Analytics and Vercel Analytics to understand how the site is used.
Google Analytics uses cookies to collect usage data anonymously. We do not collect anything that identifies you, such as your name or email address.
We anonymously record the puzzle number, your 🟩🟨🟥 results, a rough range of your streak, and your display language. We never send the actions you chose (such as call) or your cards.
This device stores only your answers and your chosen language.
To stop this data collection, use your browser settings or the Google Analytics Opt-out Add-on.
privacy.bodyBasic:
Daily Poker uses Vercel Analytics to count page views.
Vercel Analytics does not use cookies. We do not collect anything that identifies you, such as your name or email address.
Your answers and results are not sent anywhere.
This device stores only your answers and your chosen language.
